_README: NSE symbols whose bse_scrips by_id / BSE scrip_id match points at a DIFFERENT company (ISINs disagree). Consumed by bse_resolve.py, which refuses to resolve these symbols to a BSE scrip. Regenerate with scan_scrip_isin_conflicts.py --write. Runbook §76.

FOCUS.note: Our FOCUS = Focus Lighting and Fixtures Ltd (NSE); BSE 543312 is Focus Business Solution Ltd. Found by the 2026-08-10 scan, not by a data defect: every stored FOCUS row's announce date matches its OWN NSE broadcast dates, so the rows came from the NSE route and the mis-map had not (yet) been used to fill them. FOCUS values were NOT value-audited against its filings — only the mapping was proven wrong.

KALYANI.note: Our KALYANI = Kalyani Commercials Ltd, NSE-only — it has NO BSE listing at all (0 records for INE610E01010 in the 10,786-row active-equity master). BSE 544023's scrip_id is the string 'KALYANI' by coincidence. It poisoned std PAT Mar-24/Dec-24/Mar-25, invented con values for a std-only filer, and supplied the Mar-24 announce date. Healed 2026-08-10 (runbook §73/§76).
